title: Men’s Electric Razors: Good Housekeeping Lab Picks
desc: Four Good Housekeeping Institute electric razor picks from Lab testing, consumer testing and at-home use. The source assigns each a distinct use-case award; entries are not one-to-one performance ranks.

source.name: Good Housekeeping Institute — Best Men’s Electric Razors (2026)
source.note: All four model names, award categories, numbered positions, and source-supported descriptions were checked against the complete linked Good Housekeeping guide by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-21. GH describes the selections as distinct awards; the positions are retained from the article and should not be read as a uniform comparative score. GH reports seven models evaluated in lab and a 35-person consumer panel.

items.name: Panasonic ARC6 Luxury 6-Blade Men’s Electric Shaver
items.detail: Best overall; highest-scoring electric razor in the GH Beauty Lab test and top ratings for closeness, speed and comfort.

items.name: Philips Norelco OneBlade 360 Face Hybrid Trimmer and Shaver
items.detail: Best value; close wet or dry shave in a compact travel-friendly design.

items.name: Philips Norelco S9000 Prestige Electric Shaver
items.detail: Best rotary; testers rated it highly for removing hair around the upper lip and mouth.

items.name: ConairMan Ultimate Trim Precision All-in-One Groomer
items.detail: Best all-in-one; four interchangeable shaving and grooming heads.
